name: sprite-fusion
description: Generate, edit, style-match, create directional variations of, and animate pixel art with Sprite Fusion.

interface.longDescription: Create true, pixel-perfect pixel sprites for your game, edit existing sprites, match visual references, generate eight directions, and animate them using the Sprite Fusion Pixel Art Generator API. Save generated files and reuse your asset library for follow-up work. Requires Python 3 and your Sprite Fusion API key; generation uses your account credits.
defaultPrompt: Create eight directions from my character sprite.
Animate my sprite with a looping walk cycle.
